edges.reason: transfer reads and debits balances[msg.sender].
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender allowance key.
approveAndCall sets the allowance for msg.sender and forwards it to the callback.
onlyOwner modifier gates transferOwnership on require(msg.sender == owner).
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before rotating ownership.
owner state variable is compared against msg.sender in the onlyOwner modifier.
owner is used as the recipient of the rescued ERC20 tokens.
acceptOwnership reads newOwner, promotes it to owner and resets it.
totalSupply returns _totalSupply minus the address(0) balance.
balanceOf returns balances[tokenOwner].
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping.
transferFrom debits and credits the balances mapping.
approve assigns the allowed mapping entry.
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender].
allowance returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approveAndCall assigns the allowed mapping entry before the external call.
Constructor sets _totalSupply to the fixed 1000000000000000 value.
Constructor mints the entire supply into balances of a hardcoded address.
safeAdd executes the addition a + b.
safeSub executes the subtraction a - b.
safeMul executes the multiplication a * b.
safeDiv executes the division a / b.
transfer credits the recipient with safeAdd.
transfer debits the sender with safeSub.
transferFrom credits the recipient with safeAdd.
transferFrom debits balances and allowances with safeSub.
totalSupply performs an unchecked subtraction against the address(0) balance.
approveAndCall hands control to the caller-supplied spender contract via receiveApproval.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call into an owner-supplied token contract.

Local c receives the result of the multiplication.
Parameter a is the dividend of the division.
Parameter b is the divisor of the division.
Local c receives the result of the division.
tokenOwner indexes the balances mapping in balanceOf.
to is the credited recipient in transfer.
tokens is the debited/credited amount in transfer.
spender indexes the allowed mapping in approve.
tokens is stored as the allowance in approve.

spender is the second index of the allowance lookup.
spender receives the allowance in approveAndCall.
tokens is the allowance amount forwarded to the callback.
data is forwarded verbatim to the receiveApproval callback.
Caller-supplied spender determines the target contract of the external call.
Caller-supplied data is passed into the external receiveApproval call.
tokenAddress determines which external contract is invoked.
tokens is the amount forwarded to the external token transfer.
_newOwner is written into the newOwner state variable.
